# Crocs, Inc. - historical financial data

**Ticker:** CROX | **CIK:** 0001334036 | **Retrieved/as of:** 2026-09-13 UTC

## Basis, coverage and limitations

Normalized monetary tables are **USD millions**, shares are **millions**, EPS is **USD per share**. Ratios ending `_pct` are percentages; other ratios are multiples or days as labelled. Native statement tables retain the original reported scale. N/A means missing, not safely mapped, or not meaningful; it is not zero. Parentheses mean negative amounts.

Annual values use the latest available annual comparative presentation, supplemented by newer eligible SEC facts; original statement versions remain below. This is a current historical reconstruction, NOT point-in-time backtest data. Fields can originate in different restatement vintages; the lineage table identifies each.

- Annual operations and cash-flow history begins in FY2002; complete primary balance-sheet history begins at 2003-12-31. FY2002 is the inception/start-up year, not a mature full-year comparator. No complete FY2002 balance sheet is claimed.
- All available 10-Ks and 10-K/A amendments in SEC submissions through the retrieval date were downloaded, plus the earliest S-1 and latest 10-Q. The official IR financial-results grid itself covers fewer years. Older history is recovered from the SEC original filings linked conceptually by Crocs' SEC archive, not represented as an IR CDN download.
- The 2005 S-1 mixes annual, first-quarter and pro-forma columns. These were inspected and explicitly labelled; only the actual annual columns enter annual history. Short-span pro-forma EPS rows remain in a separate source-only table and never enter the normalized series.
- Pre-IPO EPS and share counts use historical capital structures. Values are reported in the selected filing's split/reclassification basis; no unverified global split adjustment was applied. Do not treat the earliest EPS as directly comparable to modern EPS.
- Borrowings use reported carrying values, reconciled to borrowing notes where amounts moved into other liabilities. Finance/capital leases are included where the selected source combines them; the later borrowings-only presentation can exclude them, so the lease perimeter is not perfectly uniform over this long history. Operating leases are separate. This is not contractual principal or a complete guarantee/contingent-obligation schedule. FY2003 debt-based normalized fields are withheld because the member-loan classification in other liabilities needs separate review; the original balance sheet and cash flows remain below.
- ROIC uses average beginning/ending borrowing carrying value plus equity plus separately presented redeemable capital less all cash. Goodwill is included. The 21% tax rate is an analyst sensitivity convention, not a historical US/worldwide tax estimate. Reported-ETR ROIC is withheld for nonpositive pretax income or tax rates outside 0-100%. Neither proxy is issuer-adjusted ROIC.
- FCF is CFO less cash purchases of property, equipment and software; it is not maintenance-only owner earnings or FCFF. Cash-flow D&A produces an EBITDA proxy, not management's adjusted EBITDA. SBC is shown separately and remains an owner cost.
- NI attributable to common can differ materially from consolidated NI when preferred distributions/redemption charges apply. For FY2009-2011, the original statements show no separate common-income deduction; common NI is explicitly mapped to reported NI.
- Blank/unreported common cash dividends are not zero-filled. Ratios requiring those amounts remain N/A. Price-dependent ratios (P/E, P/B, EV multiples and dividend yield) are not calculated without a dated market price and matching share/enterprise-value basis.
- SEC Company Facts provides standard-taxonomy entity-wide facts, not every company-specific extension, segment dimension, non-GAAP reconciliation, contract or narrative note. Primary statement rows and all eligible retrieved standard-fact series are retained; complete footnote/segment/adjusted-data coverage is not claimed.
- The latest interim source is the June 30, 2026 10-Q. Quarterly and YTD durations in the tagged appendix are kept separate and never added together blindly. No fourth-quarter values are manufactured by subtracting rounded annual and interim figures.
- Local tools exercised: EdgarTools 5.58.0 filing.markdown(), deterministic BeautifulSoup/lxml statement extraction, SEC actual-period fact selection, and PyMuPDF4LLM 1.28.2 on the IR-linked FY2025 PDF's statement pages. Docling and OCR for scanned documents were not benchmarked or deployed; this pilot used text-based reports.
- Per user instruction, source PDFs, HTML, JSON, conversions and temporary environments are not retained after final verification. Source URLs, selected accession/periods, extraction locators and exact downloaded-byte hashes are retained in this file. Refresh requires downloading again; this is intentionally not a persistent raw archive.

|---|---|
| fcf | CFO - capex; USD. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |

| ebitda_proxy | Operating income + cash-flow D&A; USD; proxy, not adjusted EBITDA. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| gross_margin_pct | Gross profit / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| operating_margin_pct | Operating income / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| net_margin_pct | Net income / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| fcf_margin_pct | FCF / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| ebitda_margin_pct | EBITDA proxy / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| effective_tax_rate_pct | Tax expense / positive pretax income * 100; %; may be anomalous. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| roe_pct | Net income attributable to common / average common equity * 100; %; both equity endpoints strictly positive. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| roa_pct | Net income / average total assets * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| total_debt | Supplied total_debt, else debt_current + debt_noncurrent only when both are present; USD; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| net_debt | Total debt - cash; USD; negative means net cash; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| roic_proxy_pct | Operating income * (1 - assumed tax rate) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %. Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| roic_reported_etr_pct | Operating income * (1 - reported ETR) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %; only ETR in [0, 1]; total-entity ETR, not operating tax. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| roce_pct | Operating income / average(assets - current liabilities) * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| current_ratio | Current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| quick_ratio | (Cash + receivables), conservative quick assets excluding other current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| cash_ratio | Cash / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| debt_to_equity | Total debt / positive closing total equity; multiple; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| net_debt_to_ebitda | Net debt / positive EBITDA proxy; multiple; negative means net cash. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| interest_coverage | Operating income / positive gross interest expense; multiple; no interest income netting. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| cash_conversion_ratio | CFO / positive net income; multiple; earnings cash conversion, not CCC days. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| accrual_ratio_pct | (Net income - CFO) / average assets * 100; %; cash-flow-based accrual proxy. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| asset_turnover | Revenue / average total assets; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| receivables_turnover | Total revenue (credit-sales proxy) / average receivables; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| inventory_turnover | Cost of revenue / average inventory; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| payables_turnover | Cost of revenue (purchases proxy) / average payables; multiple. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| dso_days | 91 * average receivables / total revenue; credit-sales proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| dio_days | 91 * average inventory / cost of revenue; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| dpo_days | 91 * average payables / cost of revenue; purchases proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| ccc_days | DSO + DIO - DPO; days; negative cycles are possible. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| revenue_growth_pct | (Current revenue - previous revenue) / positive previous revenue * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| eps_basic_growth_pct | (Current eps_basic - previous eps_basic) / positive previous eps_basic * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| eps_diluted_growth_pct | (Current eps_diluted - previous eps_diluted) / positive previous eps_diluted * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| fcf_growth_pct | (Current fcf - previous fcf) / positive previous fcf * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| capex_to_revenue_pct | capex / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| sbc_to_revenue_pct | sbc / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| buybacks_to_revenue_pct | buybacks / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| dividends_to_revenue_pct | dividends / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| shareholder_distributions | Buybacks + dividends; unsigned USD cash expenditure. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| buybacks_to_fcf_pct | buybacks / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| dividends_to_fcf_pct | dividends / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |
| shareholder_distributions_to_fcf_pct | shareholder_distributions / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30 (91 days), not annualized; opening balances 2026-03-31; growth compares Q2 2025. |

- FCF after SBC is not owner earnings; total capex is used.
- EBITDA proxy uses cash-flow D&A, which may differ from operating D&A; not issuer EBITDA or adjusted EBITDA.
- invested capital average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback.
- ROIC proxy: Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. All cash is deducted.
- Reported-ETR ROIC is a proxy: total-entity tax can reflect financing, jurisdictions and one-offs, not operating tax.
- DSO uses total revenue as a credit-sales proxy; DPO uses cost of revenue as a purchases proxy. Align flows, endpoints and days.
- Unavailable (missing inputs, invalid/nonpositive denominator, invalid capital endpoints, anomalous ETR or overflow): fcf, fcf_after_sbc, fcf_margin_pct, total_debt, net_debt, roic_proxy_pct, roic_reported_etr_pct, debt_to_equity, net_debt_to_ebitda, cash_conversion_ratio, accrual_ratio_pct, eps_basic_growth_pct, eps_diluted_growth_pct, fcf_growth_pct, capex_to_revenue_pct, sbc_to_revenue_pct, buybacks_to_revenue_pct, dividends_to_revenue_pct, shareholder_distributions, buybacks_to_fcf_pct, dividends_to_fcf_pct, shareholder_distributions_to_fcf_pct

| Metric | Period-specific definition |
|---|---|
| fcf | CFO - capex; USD. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| fcf_after_sbc | FCF - SBC; USD; not owner earnings (no maintenance capex estimate). Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| ebitda_proxy | Operating income + cash-flow D&A; USD; proxy, not adjusted EBITDA. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| gross_margin_pct | Gross profit / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| operating_margin_pct | Operating income / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| net_margin_pct | Net income / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| fcf_margin_pct | FCF / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| ebitda_margin_pct | EBITDA proxy / revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| effective_tax_rate_pct | Tax expense / positive pretax income * 100; %; may be anomalous. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| roe_pct | Net income attributable to common / average common equity * 100; %; both equity endpoints strictly positive. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| roa_pct | Net income / average total assets * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| total_debt | Supplied total_debt, else debt_current + debt_noncurrent only when both are present; USD; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| net_debt | Total debt - cash; USD; negative means net cash; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| roic_proxy_pct | Operating income * (1 - assumed tax rate) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %. Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| roic_reported_etr_pct | Operating income * (1 - reported ETR) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %; only ETR in [0, 1]; total-entity ETR, not operating tax. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| roce_pct | Operating income / average(assets - current liabilities) * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| current_ratio | Current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| quick_ratio | (Cash + receivables), conservative quick assets excluding other current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| cash_ratio | Cash / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| debt_to_equity | Total debt / positive closing total equity; multiple; no lease adjustment. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| net_debt_to_ebitda | Net debt / positive EBITDA proxy; multiple; negative means net cash. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| interest_coverage | Operating income / positive gross interest expense; multiple; no interest income netting. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| cash_conversion_ratio | CFO / positive net income; multiple; earnings cash conversion, not CCC days. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| accrual_ratio_pct | (Net income - CFO) / average assets * 100; %; cash-flow-based accrual proxy. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| asset_turnover | Revenue / average total assets; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| receivables_turnover | Total revenue (credit-sales proxy) / average receivables; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| inventory_turnover | Cost of revenue / average inventory; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| payables_turnover | Cost of revenue (purchases proxy) / average payables; multiple. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| dso_days | 181 * average receivables / total revenue; credit-sales proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| dio_days | 181 * average inventory / cost of revenue; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| dpo_days | 181 * average payables / cost of revenue; purchases proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| ccc_days | DSO + DIO - DPO; days; negative cycles are possible. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| revenue_growth_pct | (Current revenue - previous revenue) / positive previous revenue * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| eps_basic_growth_pct | (Current eps_basic - previous eps_basic) / positive previous eps_basic * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| eps_diluted_growth_pct | (Current eps_diluted - previous eps_diluted) / positive previous eps_diluted * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| fcf_growth_pct | (Current fcf - previous fcf) / positive previous fcf * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| capex_to_revenue_pct | capex / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| sbc_to_revenue_pct | sbc / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| buybacks_to_revenue_pct | buybacks / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| dividends_to_revenue_pct | dividends / positive revenue * 100; %. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| shareholder_distributions | Buybacks + dividends; unsigned USD cash expenditure. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| buybacks_to_fcf_pct | buybacks / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| dividends_to_fcf_pct | dividends / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |
| shareholder_distributions_to_fcf_pct | shareholder_distributions / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025. |

- FCF after SBC is not owner earnings; total capex is used.
- EBITDA proxy uses cash-flow D&A, which may differ from operating D&A; not issuer EBITDA or adjusted EBITDA.
- invested capital average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback.
- ROIC proxy: Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. All cash is deducted.
- Reported-ETR ROIC is a proxy: total-entity tax can reflect financing, jurisdictions and one-offs, not operating tax.
- DSO uses total revenue as a credit-sales proxy; DPO uses cost of revenue as a purchases proxy. Align flows, endpoints and days.
- Unavailable (missing inputs, invalid/nonpositive denominator, invalid capital endpoints, anomalous ETR or overflow): total_debt, net_debt, roic_proxy_pct, roic_reported_etr_pct, debt_to_equity, net_debt_to_ebitda, eps_basic_growth_pct, eps_diluted_growth_pct, dividends_to_revenue_pct, shareholder_distributions, dividends_to_fcf_pct, shareholder_distributions_to_fcf_pct
- Period 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 (181 days), not annualized; opening balances 2025-12-31; growth compares H1 2025.

## Calculated cash measures, returns, margins and ratios

ROIC is explicitly a proxy, not an issuer-reported fact. The assumed-tax proxy uses the stated tax assumption. Debt is reported borrowing carrying value, not face value; finance leases remain included where inseparable from old borrowing rows. Operating lease liabilities are shown separately. Redeemable/preferred capital must not silently disappear from the capital base.

### Calculation definitions

| Metric | Formula / convention |
|---|---|
| fcf | CFO - capex; USD. |
| fcf_after_sbc | FCF - SBC; USD; not owner earnings (no maintenance capex estimate). |
| ebitda_proxy | Operating income + cash-flow D&A; USD; proxy, not adjusted EBITDA. |
| gross_margin_pct | Gross profit / revenue * 100; %. |
| operating_margin_pct | Operating income / revenue * 100; %. |
| net_margin_pct | Net income / revenue * 100; %. |
| fcf_margin_pct | FCF / revenue * 100; %. |
| ebitda_margin_pct | EBITDA proxy / revenue * 100; %. |
| effective_tax_rate_pct | Tax expense / positive pretax income * 100; %; may be anomalous. |
| roe_pct | Net income attributable to common / average common equity * 100; %; both equity endpoints strictly positive. |
| roa_pct | Net income / average total assets * 100; %. |
| total_debt | Supplied total_debt, else debt_current + debt_noncurrent only when both are present; USD; no lease adjustment. |
| net_debt | Total debt - cash; USD; negative means net cash; no lease adjustment. |
| roic_proxy_pct | Operating income * (1 - assumed tax rate) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %. Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. |
| roic_reported_etr_pct | Operating income * (1 - reported ETR) / average(total debt + equity + separately presented redeemable capital - cash); goodwill included; no lease adjustment * 100; %; only ETR in [0, 1]; total-entity ETR, not operating tax. |
| roce_pct | Operating income / average(assets - current liabilities) * 100; %. |
| current_ratio | Current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. |
| quick_ratio | (Cash + receivables), conservative quick assets excluding other current assets / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. |
| cash_ratio | Cash / current liabilities; closing balances; multiple. |
| debt_to_equity | Total debt / positive closing total equity; multiple; no lease adjustment. |
| net_debt_to_ebitda | Net debt / positive EBITDA proxy; multiple; negative means net cash. |
| interest_coverage | Operating income / positive gross interest expense; multiple; no interest income netting. |
| cash_conversion_ratio | CFO / positive net income; multiple; earnings cash conversion, not CCC days. |
| accrual_ratio_pct | (Net income - CFO) / average assets * 100; %; cash-flow-based accrual proxy. |
| asset_turnover | Revenue / average total assets; multiple. |
| receivables_turnover | Total revenue (credit-sales proxy) / average receivables; multiple. |
| inventory_turnover | Cost of revenue / average inventory; multiple. |
| payables_turnover | Cost of revenue (purchases proxy) / average payables; multiple. |
| dso_days | days_in_year * average receivables / total revenue; credit-sales proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. |
| dio_days | days_in_year * average inventory / cost of revenue; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. |
| dpo_days | days_in_year * average payables / cost of revenue; purchases proxy; days; requires positive flow and balance endpoints. |
| ccc_days | DSO + DIO - DPO; days; negative cycles are possible. |
| revenue_growth_pct | (Current revenue - previous revenue) / positive previous revenue * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. |
| eps_basic_growth_pct | (Current eps_basic - previous eps_basic) / positive previous eps_basic * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. |
| eps_diluted_growth_pct | (Current eps_diluted - previous eps_diluted) / positive previous eps_diluted * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. |
| fcf_growth_pct | (Current fcf - previous fcf) / positive previous fcf * 100; %; matched periods, no annualization. |
| capex_to_revenue_pct | capex / positive revenue * 100; %. |
| sbc_to_revenue_pct | sbc / positive revenue * 100; %. |
| buybacks_to_revenue_pct | buybacks / positive revenue * 100; %. |
| dividends_to_revenue_pct | dividends / positive revenue * 100; %. |
| shareholder_distributions | Buybacks + dividends; unsigned USD cash expenditure. |
| buybacks_to_fcf_pct | buybacks / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. |
| dividends_to_fcf_pct | dividends / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. |
| shareholder_distributions_to_fcf_pct | shareholder_distributions / positive FCF * 100; %; unavailable for zero or deficit FCF. |

Days_in_year is the actual calendar-year day count for this December-year-end series. Growth ratios are suppressed when the previous value is nonpositive; pre-IPO EPS/split comparability remains limited.

### Calculation qualifications by year

- **2002:** FCF after SBC is not owner earnings; total capex is used. EBITDA proxy uses cash-flow D&A, which may differ from operating D&A; not issuer EBITDA or adjusted EBITDA. Reported tax rate unsuitable for ROIC: pretax income is nonpositive or ETR is outside [0%, 100%]. common equity average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. assets average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. invested capital average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. ROIC proxy: Assumed tax rate 21%, not historical actual tax. All cash is deducted. Reported-ETR ROIC is a proxy: total-entity tax can reflect financing, jurisdictions and one-offs, not operating tax. capital employed average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. receivables average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. inventory average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback. payables average unavailable: two strictly positive endpoints required; no closing-balance fallback.
